usedFor: People who book on Calendly get subscribed to email or SMS marketing in Klaviyo.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting is scheduled, rescheduled, or canceled” in Calendly, then “Subscribe Profile” in Klaviyo
bestTemplate.why: It adds bookers to Klaviyo without typing, and “Subscribe Profile” covers email or SMS.

watchOut: Cancellations and reschedules also reach “Subscribe Profile”, so confirm consent before subscribing a booker.
